      "snippet": "Short answer: nothing “malicious” broke it. A handful of design choices + ChatGPT runtime limits combined into a predictable failure mode. Here’s the straight RCA.
What (actually) broke your OS

No auto-mount of Project Save Files
Your MIPS bundles were designed to be runtime-readable, but the current chat runtime does not auto-index project files unless they’re explicitly surfaced. Result: the OS booted “empty,” so research loops had no mounted corpus.
